name: makita-postgresql-postcheck-guardrail
description: Governs the Post-Check MCP Server — restricts to post-check read actions on PostgreSQL, blocks prompt injection and malicious content.
blockedInputMessaging: Operation blocked by guardrail policy. The requested input violates the MAKITA post-check guardrail. Only disaster recovery post-check operations on the PostgreSQL cluster are permitted.
blockedOutputsMessaging: Response blocked by guardrail policy. The generated output violates the MAKITA post-check guardrail constraints.

topicsConfig.name: non-dr-operations
topicsConfig.definition: Any operations that are not related to disaster recovery post-checks, new primary health verification, endpoint verification, or replication establishment checks for the MAKITA system.
